thread:
incident-bot: ⚠️ DETECTED: elevated tail latency for redwood/longform-int8-v2 after calibration rollout (rollout-id: int8-calib-2026-03-15b). p95 ~ 240ms, p99 ~ 4.2s. Streaming stalls and client timeouts observed. Auto-escalate to sev2.

sam (oncall): acknowledged. Which pool/region and how widespread?

maria (sre): us-west-2, pool dedicated-gpu-b. Calibration job completed ~3012349900. Spike started ~3012349950. Multiple hosts showing high CUDA wait times.

jess (cs): customer prod-analytics reported streaming exports stalled ~17:52 PDT. Several user sessions hit multi-second stalls and some aborted.

tyler (ml-infra): hypothesis: new int8 calibration changed kernel selection for matmul/qkv paths. For long sequence workloads (>2k tokens) we're getting higher L2 miss rate and kernel preemption -> GPU stalls. Early profiling shows increased SM idle due to syncs.

sam (oncall): can we get a quick canary routing change to steer new sessions to fp16 variant until we mitigate?

dev-runtime: yes. I can set a per-pool routing override: 25% -> fp16 fallback, ramp to 100% if metrics don't worsen. Pushing now.

ops-bot: creating override rule routing-3012350000-1: route 25% traffic to redwood/longform-fp16-stable for pool dedicated-gpu-b.

ops-bot: rule is active.

maria (sre): telemetry update after override (1m): p99 dropped from 4.2s -> ~1.1s. stream_stall_rate from 2.4% -> 0.4%. Good immediate signal.

tyler (ml-infra): I pulled kernel traces. Key points: worker-7 and worker-9 have most dequant sync warnings. RT counters: L2 miss +26%, SM utilization oscillating, context-switch retries up. Looks like the calibration selects kernel id 13 for shapes that previously used id 9; id13 has lower accuracy for long KV chaining and higher register pressure.

sam (oncall): options: 1) rollback calibration on pool, 2) keep routing override until we rollback globally, 3) slow deploy a hotfix to kernel heuristic. Which is fastest?

maria (sre): fastest is rollback per-pool. I can revert calibration to int8-calib-v6 for dedicated-gpu-b now. Tyler should freeze the global rollout.

tyler (ml-infra): freezing global rollout now (flagged). Opening bug to adjust kernel selection thresholds and to add long-context canary.

dev-runtime: running rollback commands. Example logs: 
```
> runtimesctl rollback-calib --pool dedicated-gpu-b --model redwood/longform-int8-v2 --to int8-calib-v6
> routerctl set-override --id routing-3012350000-1 --ramp 100% (keeping fp16 until rollback done)
```

ops-bot: rollback job started on 8 hosts; health checks reporting. ETA ~ 3m.

maria (sre): rollback completed on 8/8 hosts. Performing post-rollback warm checks.

dev-runtime: post-rollback metrics: p95 170ms, p99 730ms, stream_stall_rate 0.07%. Removing routing override in 30s.

ops-bot: removing override routing-3012350000-1.

jess (cs): prod-analytics confirms streaming recovered. They saw about ~20 affected sessions during the spike window but no data loss. They want an RCA and permanent mitigation ETA.

tyler (ml-infra): action items: 1) root cause analysis of kernel selection heuristics (priority), 2) perf diffs v6 vs v7 broken down by seq length and model batch size, 3) add automated long-context canary for calibration rollouts. Ill attach perf traces.

maria (sre): I'll draft postmortem with exact timeline, host list, and customer impact. Jess, can you help with customer communication and add a note about no SLA breach?

sam (oncall): lowering severity to sev3; marking incident INC-3012350000 (link: https://rwi.incidents/INC-3012350000). Assigning to tyler + maria. Handing off to maria for follow-ups.

maria (sre): taking over. Leaving runbook note: include a per-pool rollback playbook for calibration rollouts and a pre-rollout canary that exercises streaming.

incident-bot: INC-3012350000 status=mitigated severity=3 owner=maria (sre) sla_breach=false.

sam (oncall): good work. Summary: root cause likely calibration-driven kernel selection that misfires on long-context streaming paths causing dequant/context sync stalls; mitigation: per-pool rollback + temporary routing fallback; follow-ups: kernel heuristic fix + long-context canary + perf dashboards.

jess (cs): Ill send the customer a summary and the postmortem once ready.

dev-runtime: added TODO in ops runbook: add "calibration rollback checklist" and include sample commands and verification queries.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: postmortem draft due in 48h.
